% ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Registered replication (automatic). After the Oct 22 results freeze,
% autopilot/make_cr_results.py writes auto/cr_results.tex (\Rep* macros only),
% cr_results.values.json (the sidecar), the tables and the seed-spread figure.
% build.ps1 first runs make_preview.py --precheck, which validates that bundle
% (schema, output/figure/evidence hashes, every macro value and label against
% the sidecar) and writes generated/results_state.tex: the validated control
% status and late-run flags, the descriptive seed indices, the expected macros,
% the poster render of the seed-spread figure, and MD5s re-checked here.
% \ifPosterResults is true only if cr_results.tex defines the sentinel macros
% \RepEndpoint, \RepNSeedsWord, \RepLabelCentroid and \RepLabelEnvelope (the
% generator always writes them) AND a state validated for exactly this file
% exists; otherwise every result cell stays a TBD placeholder and the log has a
% POSTER-PROBLEM line, which fails the build report.
\newcommand*{\PosterAutoDir}{../../paper/genai4health2026/auto/}
\newcommand*{\PosterStateFile}{generated/results_state.tex}
\newif\ifPosterResults
\newif\ifPosterSynthetic
\newif\ifPosterSeedA
\newif\ifPosterSeedB
\newif\ifPosterSeedC
\newif\ifPosterAnyDescSeed
\newif\ifPosterSpreadFig
\newif\ifPosterLateNote
% State file interface (written by make_preview.py --precheck).
\makeatletter
\newcommand*{\PosterStateDef}[2]{\expandafter\gdef\csname PosterState#1\endcsname{#2}}
\newcommand*{\PosterExpectMacro}[1]{\expandafter\gdef\csname PosterExpect@#1\endcsname{}}
\makeatother
\ExplSyntaxOn
\ior_new:N \g__poster_scan_ior
% Synthetic marker of the generator, read as text from cr_results.tex.
\NewDocumentCommand \PosterScanMarker { m }
  {
    \file_if_exist:nT {#1}
      {
        \ior_open:Nn \g__poster_scan_ior {#1}
        \ior_str_map_inline:Nn \g__poster_scan_ior
          { \str_if_in:nnT {##1} { SYNTHETIC~DRY~RUN } { \global\PosterSynthetictrue } }
        \ior_close:N \g__poster_scan_ior
      }
  }
% \PosterIfMDfive{file}{expected}{true}{false}: the file's MD5 equals the state.
\NewDocumentCommand \PosterIfMDfive { m m m m }
  { \str_if_eq:eeTF { \file_mdfive_hash:n {#1} } {#2} {#3} {#4} }
% \PosterIfState{key}{value}{true}{false}
\NewDocumentCommand \PosterIfState { m m m m }
  { \str_if_eq:eeTF { \use:c { PosterState#1 } } {#2} {#3} {#4} }
% \PosterIfDescSeed{X}{true}{false}: seed index X is descriptive (validated
% sidecar: a seed index with runs that is not complete at the freeze).
\NewDocumentCommand \PosterIfDescSeed { m m m }
  { \exp_args:Nv \tl_if_in:nnTF { PosterStateSeedsDesc } {#1} {#2} {#3} }
% Matched-control text: the registered descriptions of pre-registration
% amendment 2, or the generator's status when no description applies.
\NewDocumentCommand \PosterControlText { }
  {
    \exp_args:Nv \str_case:nnF { PosterStateControl }
      {
        { M+ }           { \emph{placement~accounts~for~most~of~the~gap}~(registered~description) }
        { M0 }           { \emph{placement~difference~not~detected}~(registered~description) }
        { M- }           { \emph{placement~difference~reversed}~(registered~description) }
        { M_partial }    { \emph{both~contribute}~(registered~description) }
        { M_desc }       { descriptive~only~(a~run~finished~after~the~freeze) }
        { M_unassessed } { not~assessed~(no~on-time~budget~shift) }
        { M_noP }        { not~assessed~(no~\ArmBest{}~result~at~seed~A) }
        { M_na }         { not~assessed~(no~\Arm{random-cb}~result) }
        { M_incomplete } { not~assessed~(no~registered~\Arm{random}~range) }
      }
      { status~unknown,~see~the~paper \iow_term:n { POSTER-PROBLEM:~unknown~control~label } }
  }
\cs_new:Npn \__poster_late_word:n #1
  { \exp_args:Nv \str_case:nnF { PosterState#1 } { { 1 } { late } { 0 } { ontime } } { none } }
\NewDocumentCommand \PosterLogResults { }
  {
    \iow_term:x
      {
        POSTER-RESULTS:~
        \ifPosterResults loaded~(\ifPosterSynthetic SYNTHETIC~DRY~RUN\else real\fi)
        \else none~(placeholders)\ifPosterSynthetic,~SYNTHETIC~DRY~RUN~file\fi \fi
      }
    \ifPosterResults
      \iow_term:x
        {
          POSTER-RESULTS-SEEDS:~present=
          \ifPosterSeedA A\fi \ifPosterSeedB B\fi \ifPosterSeedC C\fi
          \c_space_tl descriptive=
          \tl_if_empty:cTF { PosterStateSeedsDesc } { none } { \use:c { PosterStateSeedsDesc } }
        }
      \iow_term:x
        {
          POSTER-RESULTS-CONTROL:~\use:c { PosterStateControl } \c_space_tl
          P=\__poster_late_word:n { PDesc } \c_space_tl B=\__poster_late_word:n { BDesc }
        }
      \iow_term:x
        {
          POSTER-RESULTS-FIGURE:~
          \ifPosterSpreadFig included~\use:c { PosterStateFigure } \else missing \fi
        }
    \fi
  }
\ExplSyntaxOff

}{%

  \typeout{POSTER-PROBLEM: macro #1 expected from the sidecar but not defined}}

  \else\CRCell\fi}

  \ifcsname #1\endcsname$\csname #1\endcsname$%
  \else\ifcsname PosterExpect@#1\endcsname\PosterMissing{#1}\else---\fi\fi
  \else\CRCell\fi}

  \ifcsname #1\endcsname\PosterIfState{#2}{1}{\rlap{$^{\dagger}$}}{}\fi\fi}

\newcommand{\PosterSeedCellsCentroid}{}

\newcommand{\PosterAddSeed}[1]{%
  \global\advance\PosterNSeedCols by 1
  \gappto\PosterSeedHeads{& seed #1\PosterIfDescSeed{#1}{$^{*}$}{}}%
  \gappto\PosterSeedCellsRandom{& \PosterCell{RepAUCRandomSeed#1}}%
  \gappto\PosterSeedCellsCentroid{& \PosterCell{RepAUCCentroidSeed#1}}%
  \gappto\PosterSeedCellsEnvelope{& \PosterCell{RepAUCEnvelopeSeed#1}}}
\ifPosterResults
  \ifPosterSeedA\PosterAddSeed{A}\fi
  \ifPosterSeedB\PosterAddSeed{B}\fi
  \ifPosterSeedC\PosterAddSeed{C}\fi
\fi
\ifnum\PosterNSeedCols=0
  \global\PosterNSeedCols=1
  \gdef\PosterSeedHeads{& new seeds}%
  \ifPosterResults
    \gdef\PosterSeedCellsRandom{& ---}\gdef\PosterSeedCellsCentroid{& ---}%
    \gdef\PosterSeedCellsEnvelope{& ---}%
  \else
    \gdef\PosterSeedCellsRandom{& \CRCell}\gdef\PosterSeedCellsCentroid{& \CRCell}%
    \gdef\PosterSeedCellsEnvelope{& \CRCell}%
  \fi
\fi

% Fit check: reports the spare space, or warns if the lowest block runs past
% the bottom margin (tikzposter itself never warns about this).
\makeatletter
\newdimen\Poster@bottom
\newdimen\Poster@limit
\newcommand{\PosterCheckFit}[1]{%
  \global\Poster@bottom=\TP@blocktop
  \global\advance\Poster@bottom by \TP@blockverticalspace
  \global\Poster@limit=-0.5\textheight
  \global\advance\Poster@limit by \TP@innermargin
  \ifdim\Poster@bottom<\Poster@limit
    \global\advance\Poster@limit by -\Poster@bottom
    \PackageWarningNoLine{poster}{OVERFLOW (#1): content runs \the\Poster@limit\space below the bottom margin}%
  \else
    \global\advance\Poster@bottom by -\Poster@limit
    \typeout{POSTER-FIT (#1): \the\Poster@bottom\space spare above the bottom margin}%
  \fi}
\makeatother

\begin{columns}
% ============================ LEFT COLUMN ============================
\column{0.5}

\block{Why target selection matters in OCT}{
  \raggedright
  \begin{plist}
    \item In retinal OCT the layered retina fills only a band of each B-scan;
      much of the rest is near-uniform background.
    \item I-JEPA learns by predicting the \emph{latent features} of hidden
      target blocks from visible context, but places targets uniformly.
  \end{plist}
  \vspace{0.3em}
  \KeyBox{\textbf{Question.} Does steering I-JEPA targets toward retinal tissue
    give a better frozen encoder for glaucoma detection, with the same
    architecture and latent loss?}\par
  \vspace{0.5em}
  \AnswerBox{\textbf{Answer (original single runs).} Targets on the retinal
    band scored higher than uniform I-JEPA masking at epoch 50:
    $\DOracleRandomEpFifty$ AUC with a segmentation-free intensity centroid,
    $\DEnvelopeRandomEpFifty$ with a MIRAGE envelope. More anatomical detail did
    not add gains, and guided masks also leave more context visible.\par
    \vspace{0.3em}
    \ifPosterResults
      \ifPosterSynthetic\textbf{SYNTHETIC DRY RUN:} \fi\textbf{Registered
      replication:} \ArmBest{} \emph{\RepLabelCentroid}, \Arm{envelope}
      \emph{\RepLabelEnvelope}.
    \else
      \textbf{Registered replication:} labels after the Oct~22 results freeze
      (bottom).
    \fi}
}

\block{Five target-selection strategies}{
  \centering
  \PosterFigure{1}{200mm}{fig_oct_strategies_v2_poster.pdf}\par
  \vspace{0.3em}
  \raggedright
  \Arm{random} targets cover much background; guided rectangles cluster on the
  tissue band; \Arm{anatomy-v2} targets are thin tissue-shaped components.
}

\block{Same I-JEPA, different sampler; volume-level probe}{
  \centering
  \PosterFigure{1}{216mm}{fig_oct_jepa_volume_v2_poster.pdf}\par
  \vspace{0.3em}
  \raggedright
  Only the sampler changes: $(C,T)\sim\Pi_s(\,\cdot\mid A_s(x))$ with the guide
  $A_s(x)$; encoder, EMA teacher, predictor and Smooth-L1 loss are shared.
}
\PosterCheckFit{left column}

% ============================ RIGHT COLUMN ============================
\column{0.5}

% Neutral title (R1 P2): states the single-run observation, which the
% registered replication below may or may not support.
\block{Single runs: tissue-directed rectangles scored higher}{
  \raggedright
  {\normalsize FairVision glaucoma OCT; frozen EMA encoder, mean-pooled
  features, linear probe; test $N=\Ntest$ volumes (\Npos{} glaucoma).
  All continuations start from one epoch-25 uniform I-JEPA checkpoint.\par}
  \vspace{0.4em}
  {\centering\normalsize
  \renewcommand{\mathbf}[1]{#1}%
  \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.1}
  \setlength{\tabcolsep}{0.42em}
  \begin{tabular}{@{}lcccccc@{}}
    \toprule
    & \multicolumn{2}{c}{epoch 50} & \multicolumn{2}{c}{epoch 75} & \multicolumn{2}{c}{epoch 100} \\
    \cmidrule(lr){2-3}\cmidrule(lr){4-5}\cmidrule(lr){6-7}
    strategy & AUC & $\Delta$ & AUC & $\Delta$ & AUC & $\Delta$ \\
    \midrule
    \Arm{random}   & \AUCRandomEpFifty & --- & \AUCRandomEpSeventyFive & --- & \AUCRandomEpHundred & --- \\
    \Arm{envelope} & \AUCEnvelopeEpFifty & $\DEnvelopeRandomEpFifty$ & \AUCEnvelopeEpSeventyFive & $\DEnvelopeRandomEpSeventyFive$ & \AUCEnvelopeEpHundred & $\DEnvelopeRandomEpHundred$ \\
    \ArmBest{}     & \AUCOracleEpFifty & $\DOracleRandomEpFifty$ & \AUCOracleEpSeventyFive & $\DOracleRandomEpSeventyFive$ & \AUCOracleEpHundred & $\DOracleRandomEpHundred$ \\
    \midrule
    \Arm{anatomy-v2} & \TAUCAnatomyTwoEpFifty & \TAnatomyTwoRandomEpFifty & \TAUCAnatomyTwoEpSeventyFive & \TAnatomyTwoRandomEpSeventyFive & \TAUCAnatomyTwoEpHundred & \TAnatomyTwoRandomEpHundred \\
    \Arm{cover}      & \TAUCCoverEpFifty & \TCoverRandomEpFifty & \TAUCCoverEpSeventyFive & \TCoverRandomEpSeventyFive & \TAUCCoverEpHundred & \TCoverRandomEpHundred \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabular}\par}
  \vspace{0.2em}
  {\normalsize $\Delta$: minus \Arm{random} at the same epoch; upper rows fp16
  probes, lower rows fp32 (vs an fp32 \Arm{random}); \Arm{anatomy-v2} stopped
  at epoch 75. One continuation per strategy: intervals reflect test-case
  sampling (\Nboot{} paired bootstrap resamples), not retraining.\par}
  \vspace{0.4em}
  \KeyBox{%
    \textbf{At epoch 50 (registered endpoint):} \Arm{envelope}
    $\DEnvelopeRandomEpFifty$ AUC (95\% CI $\DEnvelopeRandomEpFiftyCI$),
    \ArmBest{} (no segmenter) $\DOracleRandomEpFifty$ (95\% CI
    $\DOracleRandomEpFiftyCI$); positive at epochs 50, 75 and 100
    (\Arm{envelope} $\DEnvelopeRandomEpHundred$ to $\DEnvelopeRandomEpFifty$,
    \ArmBest{} $\DOracleRandomEpFifty$ to $\DOracleRandomEpSeventyFive$).\par
    \textbf{More anatomy did not add gains:} \Arm{anatomy-v2} minus
    \Arm{envelope} $\DAnatomyTwoEnvelopeEpFifty$ at epoch 50; \Arm{cover}
    minus \Arm{random} $\DCoverRandomEpHundred$ at epoch 100.}
}

\block{Which masks actually reach the model?}{
  \raggedright
  {\normalsize Sampler replay in each trained configuration:
  \CRAuditViews{} training views, batch \CRAuditBatch, \CRAuditSeedCount{}
  sampler seeds. Tissue is a MIRAGE-derived proxy, not ground truth.\par}
  \vspace{0.4em}
  {\centering\normalsize
  \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.1}
  \setlength{\tabcolsep}{0.38em}
  % Context (the key confound) on a light fill.
  \begin{tabular}{@{}lcccc>{\columncolor{KeyFill}}cc@{}}
    \toprule
    & tissue & target & unique & loss & context & AUC \\
    strategy & hidden & purity & targets & slots & (\% grid) & ep.\ 50 \\
    \midrule
    \Arm{random}     & \CRHidRandom\%     & \CRPurRandom\%     & \CRUniqRandom     & \CRSlotsRandom     & $\CRCtxRandom\pm\CRCtxSDRandom$         & \AUCRandomEpFifty \\
    \ArmBest{}       & \CRHidCentroid\%   & \CRPurCentroid\%   & \CRUniqCentroid   & \CRSlotsCentroid   & $\CRCtxCentroid\pm\CRCtxSDCentroid$     & \AUCOracleEpFifty \\
    \Arm{envelope}   & \CRHidEnvelope\%   & \CRPurEnvelope\%   & \CRUniqEnvelope   & \CRSlotsEnvelope   & $\CRCtxEnvelope\pm\CRCtxSDEnvelope$     & \AUCEnvelopeEpFifty \\
    \Arm{cover}      & \CRHidCover\%      & \CRPurCover\%      & \CRUniqCover      & \CRSlotsCover      & $\CRCtxCover\pm\CRCtxSDCover$           & \AUCCoverEpFifty \\
    \Arm{anatomy-v2} & \CRHidAnatomyTwo\% & \CRPurAnatomyTwo\% & \CRUniqAnatomyTwo & \CRSlotsAnatomyTwo & $\CRCtxAnatomyTwo\pm\CRCtxSDAnatomyTwo$ & \AUCAnatomyTwoEpFifty \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabular}\par}
  \vspace{0.3em}
  \begin{plist}
    \item Guided rectangles also leave more context visible than
      \Arm{random}: \ArmBest{} $+\CRCtxGapCentroid$ points (95\% CI
      \CRCtxGapCentroidCI), \Arm{envelope} $+\CRCtxGapEnvelope$
      (\CRCtxGapEnvelopeCI).
    \item \Arm{anatomy-v2} has the purest targets (\CRPurAnatomyTwo\%) but
      \CRSlotsAnatomyTwo{} loss slots versus \CRSlotsRandom.
  \end{plist}
  \vspace{0.2em}
  \KeyBox{Target location, target size and visible context are coupled.}
}

\block{Takeaways}{
  \raggedright
  \begin{plist}
    \item Tissue-directed targets improved frozen glaucoma probes in the
      original runs, even with a segmentation-free intensity centroid.
    \item More anatomical specificity (tissue shapes, coverage) added no
      further gain.
    \ifPosterResults
    % Replication takeaway: only the generated label macros (digit-free
    % text), nothing beyond what the registered labels say.
    \item Target placement, target size and visible context move together.
      \ifPosterSynthetic\textbf{SYNTHETIC DRY RUN:} \fi Registered replication
      labels: \ArmBest{} \emph{\RepLabelCentroid}, \Arm{envelope}
      \emph{\RepLabelEnvelope}.
    \else
    \item Target placement, target size and visible context move together;
      matched-budget comparisons come next.
    \fi
  \end{plist}
}
